ann.t: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on Thursday, 26th November, 2026, inter-alia, considered and approved the re-appointment of the Managing Director, appointment of Statutory Auditor and Secretarial Auditor, appointment of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, appointment

The company hereby informs that M/s Sidhi Maheshwari and Associates, Practising Company secretaries, has tendered its resignation as secretarial Auditor of the company vide resignation letter dated 24th November 2026.
